title: How to make facesets for Character Generator?

posts.author: FlobOuchBoat
posts.body: Is there any way without or minimally editing assets to make facesets for VX Ace with the built-in Character Generator?

posts.author: DrFreeman
posts.body:
There are a limited number of extensions and options available for older versions of RPG Maker; however, using other tools it may be possible to create facesets that match the RTP. Some resources and tools are free, but some have fees.
The first link is for face generators for several versions of RPG Maker. I've also included some additional editors in case you or someone else wants to make other characters with faces.
Extensive list for creating faces:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/inde...source-generators-a-face-for-your-hero.37958/
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/grannys-lists-vx-ace-portraits-and-facesets.5831/
